svg.title: e1-crash-between-commit-and-vectors
svg.desc: e1-crash-between-commit-and-vectors: 10 steps over 1 day from 2026-12-01 (decision open: pins current behaviour). Actors: a1 (agent, claude-code), h (human). a committed ingest with no vectors leaves no job; only verify --repair recovers it. 1. [0d] a1 ingest # Deploy freeze → $before; expects 2 things. 2. a1 ingest # Incident bridge; expects 2 things. 3. h status; expects 4 things. 4. a1 search incident bridge scribe; expects 1 thing. 5. a1 search incident bridge scribe; expects 1 thing. 6. h verify; expects 1 thing. 7. [1d] h verify; expects 2 things. 8. h backfill; expects 3 things. 9. a1 search incident bridge scribe; expects 2 things. 10. h verify; expects 1 thing.
